sections.h2: Why is Ennis a different market from the border cities?
sections.html:
Ennis has grown fast and carries higher home values, so sellers here compete with new construction. The federal estimate puts Ennis at 25,694 residents in July 2025, up 27.6% from the April 2020 base of 20,133.

A quickly growing town gives an older house two kinds of buyers: families who want an established lot, and investors who see rental demand. A cash sale suits someone who cannot wait for either. Think about how your house compares with new homes nearby before you set an asking price.

  • Cash buyer: as-is, with a closing date you agree on.
  • Agent listing: the widest audience, with showings.
  • Family sale: quick on price and still needs a recorded deed.

sections.h2: What do the numbers say about Ennis housing?
sections.html:
Ennis reports a higher home value than El Paso or Eagle Pass, a longer commute and a larger share of residents in the labor force. The table lists the details.

A 27.6 minute average commute points to many residents working outside town, so a listing that explains road access to larger job centers can help. Keep the description to facts you can check.

sections.h2: What does the City of Ennis require for permits?
sections.html:
The city requires a building permit before anyone constructs, alters, enlarges, moves, demolishes or repairs a structure inside the city limits. Buyers ask for those records, so gather them first.

  • Accessory buildings over 120 square feet.
  • Demolition and moving a structure.
  • Drive approaches and irrigation systems.
  • Fences over 8 feet high.
  • Signs, swimming pools and spas.

Planning and Development is at 108 W. Knox Street, (972) 875-6442, open Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM. Its page links a Historic District information page, a zoning verification letter and a tool to find your zoning district. Use those to answer a buyer who wants to add a shed or a pool.

sections.h2: How long does a buyer wait on an Ennis permit?
sections.html:
The city prints review times by project size, which helps a buyer who plans work.

Plan review times as printed by Ennis Planning and Development
ProjectTime
Small residential and minor additions1 to 3 days
New residential and major additions3 to 10 days
Small commercial and minor additions3 to 10 days
New commercial and major additions14 to 28 days

The city says workload can change these. The permit holder schedules inspections, and the city has an online permits and inspections portal.

sections.h2: How do property taxes work for an Ennis seller?
sections.html:
Local taxing units set rates, the appraisal district sets value, and the year's lien attaches January 1. A sale later in the year divides the bill at closing, and the title company pays your share.

School districts give qualified homesteads a $140,000 exemption, with $60,000 more for owners 65 or older or disabled. Bills arrive around October 1, and a protest is generally due May 15. The Comptroller also lists a 10% yearly cap on a homestead's appraised value.

  • Split payment dates: November 30 and June 30.
  • Ask the county tax office for your balance.
  • Request a tax certificate for closing.

sections.h2: What about foreclosure, deeds and inheritance?
sections.html:
You can sell before an auction, and a notice of sale must precede the first-Tuesday sale by at least 21 days. After a default notice you have 20 days to catch up.

The county clerk records the deed after notary acknowledgment, and the 2023 clerk manual lists $5.00 for the first page and $4.00 for each added page. For inherited property, the State Law Library lists a small estate affidavit, a muniment of title and an affidavit of heirship.

faqs.q: How fast can an Ennis sale close?
faqs.a: A cash sale can close in a few weeks when title is clear. Ask for the date in writing.

faqs.q: Does Ennis require a permit for an old addition?
faqs.a: Ask Planning and Development at (972) 875-6442. The city requires a permit for work that alters or enlarges a structure.

faqs.q: Does Ennis have a historic district?
faqs.a: The city website lists a Historic District information page and a Historic Landmark Commission. Ask whether your address is covered.

faqs.q: Who sets the property tax for an Ennis home?
faqs.a: Local units set rates and the appraisal district sets value. Ask the county tax office for your balance.

faqs.q: Can I sell an Ennis house with a mortgage?
faqs.a: Yes. The title company pays the loan from the proceeds, so request a payoff statement.
